metadata.question: Did the nighttime brightness at Biju Patnaik Airport decrease more than the brightness at Saheed Nagar (20.290813, 85.848691) between April 30, 2019 and May 5, 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. **Search strategy**: - Need to compare nighttime brightness (NOAA VIIRS DNB - Nighttime Lights) at two locations: * Biju Patnaik Airport (need to find coordinates - it's in Bhubaneswar, India, approximately 20.2441, 85.8245) * Saheed Nagar (20.290813, 85.848691) - Date range: April 30, 2019 to May 5, 2019 - Collection: NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1_1 or VIIRS daily data 2. **Masking strategy**: - VIIRS DNB data doesn't have clouds in the same way optical data does - Need to handle no-data values and quality flags - Focus on the 'avg_rad' (average radiance) band which represents nighttime brightness 3. **Logic to distinguish**: - C1: No images found for either location during the date range - C2: Images exist but all pixels are no-data or masked - C3: Calculation produces NaN, None, or invalid values - Valid Zero: Both locations have valid readings (could be zero brightness) - **Answer A**: Decrease at Airport > Decrease at Saheed Nagar (brightness dropped more) - **Answer B**: Decrease at Airport ≤ Decrease at Saheed Nagar (brightness dropped less or increased more) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define locations const airportCoords = [85.8245, 20.2441]; // Biju Patnaik Airport, Bhubaneswar const saheedNagarCoords = [85.848691, 20.290813]; // Saheed Nagar const airportPoint = ee.Geometry.Point(airportCoords); const saheedNagarPoint = ee.Geometry.Point(saheedNagarCoords); // Date range const startDate = '2019-04-30'; const endDate = '2019-05-05'; // Load VIIRS DNB monthly data (nighttime lights) const viirsDNB = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1_1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('avg_rad'); const collectionSize = viirsDNB.size().getInfo(); print(`VIIRS DNB Images in range: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { print('No VIIRS data found for date range.'); print('C1'); return; } // Get first and last images for the period const sortedCol = viirsDNB.sort('system:time_start'); const firstImg = ee.Image(sortedCol.first()); const lastImg = ee.Image(sortedCol.sort('system:time_start', false).first()); // Get first date info const firstDate = firstImg.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo(); const lastDate = lastImg.date().format('YYYY-MM-dd').getInfo(); print(`Date range: ${firstDate} to ${lastDate}`); // Sample brightness at Airport const airportFirst = firstImg.sample(airportPoint, 1000).first().getInfo(); const airportLast = lastImg.sample(airportPoint, 1000).first().getInfo(); // Sample brightness at Saheed Nagar const saheedFirst = firstImg.sample(saheedNagarPoint, 1000).first().getInfo(); const saheedLast = lastImg.sample(saheedNagarPoint, 1000).first().getInfo(); // Extract brightness values const airportBrightFirst = airportFirst.properties.avg_rad; const airportBrightLast = airportLast.properties.avg_rad; const saheedBrightFirst = saheedFirst.properties.avg_rad; const saheedBrightLast = saheedLast.properties.avg_rad; print(`Airport - Start: ${airportBrightFirst}, End: ${airportBrightLast}`); print(`Saheed Nagar - Start: ${saheedBrightFirst}, End: ${saheedBrightLast}`); // Check for valid data if (airportBrightFirst === null || airportBrightLast === null || saheedBrightFirst === null || saheedBrightLast === null) { print('Invalid or missing brightness data at one or both locations.'); print('C2'); return; } // Calculate decrease (positive value = decrease, negative = increase) const airportDecrease = airportBrightFirst - airportBrightLast; const saheedDecrease = saheedBrightFirst - saheedBrightLast; print(`Airport brightness decrease: ${airportDecrease.toFixed(4)}`); print(`Saheed Nagar brightness decrease: ${saheedDecrease.toFixed(4)}`); // Check for NaN if (isNaN(airportDecrease) || isNaN(saheedDecrease)) { print('Calculation resulted in NaN.'); print('C3'); return; } // Compare: Did airport decrease more than Saheed Nagar? if (airportDecrease > saheedDecrease) { print('Airport brightness decreased more than Saheed Nagar.'); print('A'); } else { print('Airport brightness did not decrease more than Saheed Nagar.'); print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
